name: grokbot-telegram
description: Telegram from Cursor in two modes: Bot API (messages as your @bot) and MTProto user account (messages as you). Configure one or both.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.title: Telegram bot token (Bot API mode)
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token from @BotFather. Required only for the telegram-bot MCP server. Never commit this value. Format: 123456789:AAH...

TELEGRAM_API_ID.title: Telegram api_id (user-account mode)
TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: App api_id from https://my.telegram.org/apps. Required for the telegram-user MTProto server. Numeric string, e.g. 123456.

TELEGRAM_API_HASH.title: Telegram api_hash (user-account mode)
TELEGRAM_API_HASH.description: App api_hash from https://my.telegram.org/apps. Required for the telegram-user MTProto server. Treat as a secret.

TELEGRAM_SESSION.title: Telegram session string (user-account mode)
TELEGRAM_SESSION.description: teleproto/GramJS/Telethon-style StringSession after first login. Optional if a session file already exists. Equivalent to a password for your personal Telegram account — never commit it.

TELEGRAM_DISCLAIMER.title: Message disclaimer footer (both modes)
TELEGRAM_DISCLAIMER.description: Text appended to every message this plugin sends, so recipients know an agent sent it. Leave empty for the default ("— This message was sent by Grok Bot..."). Set to off to send messages with no footer.
